resolved_findings: Permanent internal _frame/load_source profiler call-count regression was replaced with public saved-feature behavior against a temporarily missing newly generated toy FRD. The original private diagnostic remains evidence only.
observations: Minimal existing saved-feature extension; no new recovery, interpolation formula, custom query matching or external dependency.

Changed tests cover public factory/refresh/getObservations and native GUI properties, with isolated generated toy data and restored external source bytes.

Legacy saved objects missing new properties restore Slave/MasterVertex=1 without replacing SlaveVertex=2, literal bytes, hash or Historical state; explicit fresh-source workflow remains required.

Refresh failures withdraw Available; getObservations revalidates the definition and source; restored history and recompute do not automatically refresh.
GUI default modes, editability, selector changes, native links, save/reopen selector persistence and Historical qualified-read rejection are covered.
